steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: AO1: Recall knowledge and understanding (e.g. define, state, name) | Key Fact: AO2: Apply knowledge and understanding to familiar and unfamiliar contexts (e.g. explain, describe) | Key Fact: AO3: Analyse, evaluate and make judgements (e.g. discuss, evaluate, compare) | Key Fact: Mathematical skills: using standard form, unit conversions, ratios, percentages and algebra

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from astronomy exam technique, and one past-paper question.
